name: The Shops at Riverside
summary: The Shops at Riverside is an upscale shopping destination in Hackensack featuring over 70 high-end stores, refined dining options, and a premium movie theater. This sophisticated center offers a curated retail experience that attracts discerning shoppers from throughout northern New Jersey.
demographics: The Shops at Riverside attracts an affluent, educated demographic from Bergen County and surrounding northern New Jersey communities, with median household incomes significantly above the national average. The primary trade area draws families and professionals aged 30-65 with high disposable incomes who seek premium shopping experiences. Visitors typically include dual-income households, empty nesters, and younger professionals who value quality brands and upscale dining options. The center serves as a regional destination for special occasion shopping and entertainment, drawing customers willing to travel for its curated mix of high-end retailers and refined atmosphere.
description: The Shops at Riverside stands as one of northern New Jersey's premier upscale shopping destinations, offering a sophisticated retail experience in Hackensack's bustling commercial corridor. This refined shopping center features over 70 high-end stores carefully curated to appeal to discerning shoppers seeking quality brands and exceptional service. Beyond its impressive retail offerings, the center distinguishes itself with classy dining options that transform a shopping trip into a complete lifestyle experience, complemented by an upscale movie theater that provides entertainment in elegant surroundings. The center's commitment to creating a premium atmosphere is evident in every detail, from its well-appointed common areas to its thoughtfully selected tenant mix. With convenient access from major highways and ample parking, The Shops at Riverside has established itself as a go-to destination for Bergen County residents and visitors seeking an elevated shopping experience that combines fashion, dining, and entertainment under one roof.
